effect: Ordering a company to invest (player verb finance.startCorporateInvestment, called without a decisionSource): a privately controlled company (ownership.controlled is not true) must pass the game's own profitability test (requireProfitable, as the AI's investments already do) and may have only one funded expansion project at a time (reason active_project). State-controlled companies can still be directed as before. AI investment goes through the same verb with decisionSource set (corporate_market_signal) and is left exactly as in the unmodified game. Player path only: day 0, the AI and saves unchanged. At day 0 every sector is profitable, so the profitability rule binds only once returns fall. Player-visible part: the profitability rule (the game's own UI already hides the invest button while a project is funded, so the one-at-a-time rule only binds non-UI callers). A refused order shows the game's generic "could not be executed" message: there is no locale text for project_return. (Minified names in this text are those of build 26296134; the patch's find text has the current ones.)
